1.text: Ever. True wisdom may be found in the law. It constitutes the happiness of Israel. Deut. iv. 7. Christ perfected and fulfilled it. Mat. v. 7. --- Life. Moses promised temporal blessings; (C. iii. 14. Deut. xxx. 15.) yet the faithful would be rewarded eternally. C. --- Wisdom is the law of God. C. iii. 12. W.

3.text: Nation. Be faithful, lest another take thy place. This Christians have done. Deut. xxxii. 21. C.

5.text: Memorial. Gr. lit. "O memorable Israel." H. --- Ye are left to support and restore the nation. This part of the letter is for their comfort.

6.text: Sold, like slaves, or people taken in war. C.

8.text: God. Lit. "Him." Gr. "the Eternal." H. --- This is taken from Deut. xxxii. 15. C. --- Nursed you. The city is beautifully personified as a widow. v. 12. H.

9.text: Near. Hebrew would be "daughters of Sion." v. 14.

15.text: Tongue. So the Chaldees are described, Deut. xxviii. 49. Is. xxxiii. 19. C.

16.text: Children. Gr. "daughters." H. --- Many of both sexes were taken with Jechonias. C. --- Jerusalem comforts her children, and assures them of God's mercy. W.

20.text: Peace: the ornaments worn in my prosperity. --- Sackcloth, or a rough garment, used by penitents and in times of public distress.

25.text: Neck. Mardochai, Daniel, &c. were governors. Is. xl. 14. These predictions were more fully verified when the Gentiles embraced the gospel. C.

28.text: When. Gr. "now ten times as much, being converted, seek him." H. --- The Jews became much more docile and attached to the law.

30.text: Named thee as his servant, spouse, (C.) and intimate friend.

31.text: The. Gr. Deilaioi. "wretched those who have injured thee, and rejoiced in thy fall! Wretched the cities," &c. H.

32.text: She; Babylon. Ch. --- Gr. "Wretched she," &c. H. --- Babylon shall fall a prey to Cyrus.

35.text: Fire of war. --- Devils. Whether they really dwell in ruins, or the people were of that opinion, (as the common sort are still) is not clear. Jer. l. 39. Is. xxxiv. 14.

37.text: East and west. From Babylon and from the islands. Is. xi. 11. Zac. viii. 7.
